content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured navy blue blouse with a subtle sheen, cut in a classic fit-and-flare silhouette to elongate the torso and ending at the high hip for ease of movement, crafted from lightweight ponte knit to maintain a polished shape throughout the interview. A tailored charcoal grey wool-blend blazer, featuring clean lines, notch lapels, and structured shoulders that provide professional authority while accommodating slight shifts in posture, finished with elbow-length sleeves and single-button closure. High-waisted pleated trousers in matching charcoal wool blend, offering a fluid drape from waist to ankle with a mid-calf length that avoids constriction while maintaining a sharp silhouette suitable for standing during the assessment. Flat leather loafers in a deep brown hue, constructed with a minimal heel and rounded toe to ensure comfort during the walk-and-talk portions of the conversation while projecting a grounded and reliable demeanor. A delicate gold-tone necklace with a small geometric pendant, adding a touch of warmth that complements her skin tone without appearing overpowering for a corporate setting. This outfit works perfectly because the navy blouse paired with charcoal trousers creates a sophisticated monochrome base that signals competence and seriousness appropriate for a banking environment. The tailored blazer adds the necessary layer of formality required for an interview while the pleats and mid-calf length ensure comfort during periods of standing. By avoiding black entirely in favor of navy and charcoal, the ensemble respects her specific preference while still delivering a sharp, professional look that balances authority with approachability."}
